source_path.fact: Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration owns language_model as Gemma4TextModel and exposes it through the model alias.
The deployed wrapper calls general_mm_embed_routine with language_model, then conditionally unpacks auxiliary states only from self.capture_aux_hidden_states before invoking logits_processor.
Gemma4TextModel emits auxiliary states when its layers_to_capture list is populated.

localized_defect: Repair-8 targeted Gemma4ForCausalLM, but the served checkpoint's actual top-level forward is Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration. Its wrapper capture flag remained false, so it passed None to logits despite the causal-class patch.
repair: Immediately before the deployed multimodal wrapper forward, set its capture_aux_hidden_states and its language_model.layers_to_capture. No workload, checkpoint, split, training, holdout, or endpoint behavior changes.
